title: Hans Christian Andersen Museum
geometryBasis: The exact exterior photograph already cleared and published on Qualla, the named mapped footprint and roof wing, and the museum's official history.
sectionBasis: One storey and an uneven split roof: a lower tiled range on the long front, a steep hip behind the chamfered corner, and the later chimney above the street corner.
limitations: The model represents the historic birthplace only. The 2021 Kengo Kuma museum, garden and Andersen's later childhood home are separate.
Local sill, eave and small rear openings are bounded estimates. The regional elevation raster does not resolve individual cobblestones.
